# Environment variables

!!! note "Generated page"
    `scripts/docs/gen_env.py` builds this page from the code. Text that needs a person lives in `scripts/docs/descriptions.yml`. Edit that file, not this page.

`common/settings.py` loads a `.env` file with `dotenv.load_dotenv()` when it is imported, so values in `.env` count as environment variables. Every read below sits under `api/`, `common/` or `conserver/`. Tests are left out.

A default of `none` means the read returns nothing when the variable is unset. `required` means the code raises `KeyError` when it is unset. A variable set to an empty value counts as set, so its default does not apply.

Each process reads these values when it starts, so restart it after a change. For help choosing values, see the [environment guide](../configuration/environment-variables.md).

The code reads 40 variables.

| Variable | Default | Type | Read in | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `API_ROOT_PATH` | `/api` | string | `common/settings.py` | FastAPI `root_path` for the API app, for a proxy that strips this prefix. Route paths do not change. |
| `CONSERVER_API_TOKEN` | none | string | `common/settings.py` | One API key for the main API routes. With neither this nor `CONSERVER_API_TOKEN_FILE` set, the API skips authentication on those routes. |
| `CONSERVER_API_TOKEN_FILE` | none | string | `common/settings.py` | Path to a file of API keys, one per line, read once when the API starts. Added to the keys from `CONSERVER_API_TOKEN`. |
| `CONSERVER_CONFIG_FILE` | `./example_config.yml` in `common/settings.py`<br>none in `api/api.py` | string | `api/api.py`<br>`common/settings.py` | Path to the YAML configuration. `common/config.py` reads it through the setting and its default. The `POST /config` handler reads the variable directly, with no default, to write the file. An empty value fails when the file is opened. |
| `CONSERVER_HEADER_NAME` | `x-conserver-api-token` | string | `common/settings.py` | HTTP header that carries the API key. The follower also sends its auth token in this header. |
| `CONSERVER_PARALLEL_STORAGE` | `true` | boolean | `common/settings.py` | When true, and a chain has more than one storage backend, writes run in parallel. `true`, `1` and `yes` count as true, in any case. |
| `CONSERVER_START_METHOD` | `""` | string | `common/settings.py` | Multiprocessing start method, one of `fork`, `spawn` or `forkserver`. Used only when `CONSERVER_WORKERS` is above 1. Empty or unset uses the Python platform default. Any other value raises `ValueError` at startup. |
| `CONSERVER_VCON_CONCURRENCY` | `1` | integer | `common/settings.py` | In-flight vCons per worker process. Values under 1 become 1, which processes vCons serially. |
| `CONSERVER_WORKERS` | `1` | integer | `common/settings.py` | Number of worker processes. Values under 1 become 1. |
| `DEEPGRAM_KEY` | none | string | `common/settings.py` | Read into `settings`, but no code uses that setting. The `deepgram_link` link takes its key from link options. |
| `EGRESS_FORMAT_VERSION` | none | string | `common/settings.py` | Legacy vCon version string emitted by the `webhook` link, the `postgres`, `s3` and `elasticsearch` storage adapters and the `GET /vcon/{uuid}` and `GET /vcons` reads. `0.0.1` is the only supported value. Empty or unset emits the current spec. Redis and link processing stay on the current spec either way. |
| `ENV` | `dev` in `common/settings.py`<br>required in `common/lib/error_tracking.py` | string | `common/lib/error_tracking.py`<br>`common/settings.py` | Sentry environment name. The `settings` value is unused. `common/lib/error_tracking.py` reads the variable directly when `SENTRY_DSN` is set, and has no default. |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | `YOUR_GROQ_API_KEY` | string | `conserver/links/groq_whisper/__init__.py` | Default `API_KEY` option for the `groq_whisper` link. |
| `HOSTNAME` | `http://localhost:8000` | string | `common/settings.py` | Read into `settings`, but no code uses that setting. |
| `LOGGING_CONFIG_FILE` | `logging.conf` beside `common/settings.py` | string | `common/settings.py` | Path passed to `logging.config.fileConfig`. The repo also ships `common/logging_dev.conf`. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `DEBUG` | string | `common/settings.py` | Read into `settings`, but no code uses that setting. The logging config file sets log levels. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | `""` in `conserver/links/detect_engagement/__init__.py`<br>none in `common/settings.py` | string | `common/settings.py`<br>`conserver/links/detect_engagement/__init__.py` | Default `OPENAI_API_KEY` option for the `detect_engagement` link. The `settings` value is unused. Other links take the key from link options. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | none | string | `common/lib/metrics.py` | OTLP endpoint for metrics, passed to the gRPC exporter in `common/lib/metrics.py`. Unset or empty, the metric helpers do nothing. |
| `OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL` | `5000` | integer | `common/lib/metrics.py` | Metric export interval in milliseconds. |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | `vcon-server` | string | `common/lib/metrics.py` | Value of the `service.name` resource attribute on metrics. The Compose file sets `conserver` and `api`. |
| `REDIS_URL` | `redis://localhost` | string | `common/settings.py` | Redis connection URL. `docker/wait_for_redis.sh` reads it too, and skips its wait when it is unset or empty. |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | none | string | `common/lib/error_tracking.py` | Sentry DSN. Unset, Sentry stays off. Set, `ENV` must be in the process environment too. |
| `SXT_API_KEY` | none | string | `common/storage/spaceandtime/__init__.py` | Space and Time API key for the `spaceandtime` storage adapter. |
| `SXT_VCON_TABLENAME` | none | string | `common/storage/spaceandtime/__init__.py` | Table name for the `spaceandtime` storage adapter. |
| `SXT_VCON_TABLE_WRITE_BISCUI` | none | string | `common/storage/spaceandtime/__init__.py` | Write biscuit for the `spaceandtime` storage adapter. The code reads this exact name, which lacks the final `T` of the Python constant `SXT_VCON_TABLE_WRITE_BISCUIT`. |
| `TICK_INTERVAL` | `5000` | integer | `common/settings.py` | Read into `settings`, but no code uses that setting. |
| `UUID8_DOMAIN_NAME` | a domain set in code | string | `common/vcon.py` | Read into a constant in `common/vcon.py`, but no code uses that constant. |
| `VCON_CONTEXT_EXPIRY` | `86400` | integer | `common/settings.py` | Seconds before ingress context data expires in Redis. |
| `VCON_DLQ_EXPIRY` | `604800` | integer | `common/settings.py` | TTL in seconds for a vCon in a dead letter queue. The ingress DLQ sets the TTL to this value. The storage DLQ only raises a lower TTL. `0` leaves the existing TTL alone. |
| `VCON_INDEX_EXPIRY` | `86400` | integer | `common/settings.py` | Seconds before the search index keys written by the API expire. |
| `VCON_REDIS_EXPIRY` | `3600` | integer | `common/settings.py` | TTL in seconds on vCon keys written by `POST /vcon` and `POST /vcon/external-ingress`, and on a vCon cached back from a storage backend. |
| `VCON_SERVER_BUILD_TIME` | `unknown` | string | `common/version.py` | Image build time. The Dockerfiles set it from a build argument. |
| `VCON_SERVER_GIT_COMMIT` | `unknown` in `common/version.py`<br>none in `common/lib/error_tracking.py` | string | `common/lib/error_tracking.py`<br>`common/version.py` | Git commit of the build. The Dockerfiles set it from a build argument. Sentry uses it as the release. |
| `VCON_SERVER_VERSION` | `dev` | string | `common/version.py` | Server version string. The Dockerfiles set it from a build argument. |
| `VCON_SORTED_FORCE_RESET` | `true` | string | `common/settings.py` | Read into `settings`, but no code uses that setting. |
| `VCON_SORTED_SET_NAME` | `vcons` | string | `common/settings.py` | Name of the Redis sorted set that orders vCons by timestamp. |
| `VCON_STORAGE` | `""` | string | `common/settings.py` | PostgreSQL connection string. When set, `api/api.py` defines a Peewee model on it, but no code uses that model. |
| `VCON_STORAGE_FALLBACK_ENABLED` | `true` | boolean | `common/settings.py` | When true, a Redis miss in `VconRedis.get_vcon` tries the configured storage backends and caches the first hit back in Redis. `true`, `1` and `yes` count as true, in any case. |
| `WEVIATE_API_KEY` | none | string | `common/settings.py` | Read into `settings`, but no code uses that setting. The spelling is the one in the code. |
| `WEVIATE_HOST` | `localhost:8000` | string | `common/settings.py` | Read into `settings`, but no code uses that setting. The spelling is the one in the code. |

## Dynamic reads

These reads compute the variable name at run time, so the table cannot list them.

| File | Expression |
|---|---|
| `conserver/links/groq_whisper/__init__.py` | `var in os.environ` |

The dynamic read in `groq_whisper` does not configure anything. When that link module loads, it deletes `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY` and their lowercase forms from the process environment.

## Variables outside the server code

Scripts, Docker Compose and the OpenTelemetry tools read these. The table above leaves them out because no code under `api/`, `common/` or `conserver/` reads them.

| Variable | Read by | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMPOSE_PROFILES` | Docker Compose | none | Comma-separated profiles to start: `postgres`, `elasticsearch`, `langfuse`. |
| `CONSERVER_EXTERNAL_PORT` | `docker-compose.yml` | `8000` | Host port published for the `api` service. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` | `opentelemetry-instrument` | empty | Headers for OTLP export. Compose passes it to `api` and `conserver`. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_INSECURE` | `opentelemetry-instrument` | `false` in Compose | Turns off TLS for OTLP export. Compose passes it to `api` and `conserver`. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` | `opentelemetry-instrument` | `grpc` in Compose | OTLP protocol. The custom metrics in `common/lib/metrics.py` always use the gRPC exporter, whatever this says. |
| `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` | `opentelemetry-instrument` | `deployment.environment=dev` in Compose | Resource attributes. The Compose file fixes this value for `api` and `conserver`. |
| `REDIS_MIGRATION_SOURCE_URL` | `scripts/migrate_redis_json.py` | required | Redis URL to copy from. See the [Redis migration](../installation/redis-migration.md). |
| `REDIS_MIGRATION_TARGET_URL` | `scripts/migrate_redis_json.py` | required | Redis URL to copy to. |
